fields.subject: Postgres Connection Settings
fields.where: an entry of the PgDbConnections configuration array declares PostgreSQL connection settings directly on the entry (alongside its DatabaseKey) rather than under ReadConnection or WriteConnection
fields.trigger: the configured databases resolve the connection strings of that entry's read and write endpoints
fields.response: apply the entry's own settings as the database level of the Configuration hierarchy for both endpoints, between the global settings and each endpoint's local settings
fields.postcondition: a database-level setting overrides the same global setting and is shared by the read and write endpoints unless an endpoint's local setting overrides it
